queries: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(1.0 * HGB / HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM patient_ratios), above_overall AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS group_avg FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(a.ratio - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(a.ratio - g.group_avg) AS avg_above_group FROM above_overall a CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN group_mean g WHERE a.ratio > g.group_avg

assumptions.assumption: A patient's ratio is the average of their individual lab test ratios, using tests with both values present and a nonzero HCT. Each patient counts once in the subsequent averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate each patient's ratio by dividing their average HGB by their average HCT, using the same eligible tests.
